findings.claim: Rule 2 says v2 generates hook matchers per agent from adapters/table.ts, but no doc names #547 or Codex's limit: Codex uses the Rust regex crate (no look-around) and only skips the regex engine when the matcher is charset [A-Za-z0-9_|]. A generated matcher like v1.0.124's `mcp__(?!.*context-mode)` breaks every Codex user at boot. #547 sits only in v2-test-ledger.md:132 as 'GP3 hooks' with no GP case.
findings.evidence: grep '#547|look-around|is_exact_matcher' over PRD-v2.md docs/v2/*.md docs/v2/adr/*.md tickets/map-*.md tickets/v2-issue-map.md: no match. cm-main src/adapters/codex/hooks.ts:44-60 and index.ts:80-95. isall.json: 547 CLOSED 'Bug: Codex PreToolUse hook matcher uses unsupported regex lookahead'.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 675fec69 2026-05-13 'fix(codex): drop look-around from PreToolUse matcher (closes #547 partial)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'Codex's Rust regex crate does NOT support look-around, so it rejects the matcher at boot ... every Codex user on v1.0.124 is broken. Pin Codex matchers to charset [A-Za-z0-9_|] so is_exact_matcher short-circuits the regex engine. Hook BODY's isExternalMcpTool() filter preserves end-to-end semantics.' REGRESSION_RISK: v2's one-generator-for-all-agents design re-creates the 3900db8c-style look-around matcher for Codex. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: per-agent matcher grammar column in the adapter table; Codex row charset [A-Za-z0-9_|] only; own-vs-external split in the hook body, not the matcher; keep test 'Codex matcher #547 — is_exact_matcher charset compliance' (tests/adapters/codex.test.ts) KEEP-PASS.
findings.fix: Add to §3.8 rule 2: 'Each adapter row states its matcher grammar. Codex: literal [A-Za-z0-9_|] only, no look-around (#547). Own-tool filtering happens in the hook body.' Add a GP3 case per agent that loads the generated matcher with that agent's real matcher engine.

findings.claim: Codex row states one fixed name shape, but Codex has a feature flag that removes the mcp__ prefix from model-visible MCP names. It is off now. The doc does not record it, so a flip changes hook payload names with no test to catch it.
findings.evidence: /tmp/wf4/cx_feat.rs:268 '/// Expose MCP model-visible namespaces without the legacy `mcp__` prefix. NonPrefixedMcpToolNames'; :1598-1601 key 'non_prefixed_mcp_tool_names', stage UnderDevelopment, default_enabled false. Also note v1 tool-naming.mjs:32 sets codex to bare names while src/adapters/codex/hooks.ts:46 says hook tool_name is mcp__<server>__<tool>.
findings.fix: Add to the Codex row: 'flag non_prefixed_mcp_tool_names (default off) changes this; GP3 S-NAMES records names from a live Codex payload on every release'.

findings.claim: The plugin tool name is cited to the 'docs plugins section'. The rule is in the MCP and hooks docs, and the docs add that chars outside A-Za-z0-9_- become '_' (the doc leaves that out).
findings.evidence: /tmp/wf4/doc-mcp.md:515 'The full form is mcp__plugin_<plugin-name>_<server-name>__<tool-name>, where any character outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _, and - is replaced with _'; /tmp/wf4/doc-hooks.md:371 same form; grep in doc-plugins.md: no match.
findings.fix: Cite the MCP docs 'Plugin-provided MCP servers' section and add the sanitize rule.

findings.claim: Pi row says v2's in-process plugin 'registers its own names'. v1 learned that Pi gives MCP-registered tools the 'context_mode_' prefix and had to map it back (#624). The doc keeps no trace of this, so v2 event extraction can miss its own tools on Pi.
findings.evidence: cm-main src/adapters/pi/extension.ts:540-544 'Pi namespaces MCP-registered tools with the "context_mode_" prefix; the extract functions expect the "mcp__" prefix'; tests/pi-extension.test.ts:150 "maps 'context_mode_' pre...". grep '624|context_mode_' in tickets/v2-issue-map.md and TECH-SPEC: no Pi match.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: b7597092 2026-05-19 'fix(pi): normalise context_mode_ prefix and path→file_path for event extraction (#624)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: code comment above. REGRESSION_RISK: Pi events for own tools are not recognised. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: v2 records the exact name Pi passes in tool events and tests it in GP3 S-NAMES.
